zh: 你好，我是陈默，一名在杭州写代码第六年的全栈工程师。我相信好的软件是「删」出来的——把不必要的复杂度一层层削掉，剩下的才是产品本身。
白天我用 TypeScript 和 Go 搭服务，晚上维护几个开源小项目。我对编辑器、开发者工具和「小而确定」的软件有执念：一个工具如果能小于 100kb 还让人惊艳，那它就值得存在。
不写代码的时候，我在学英语、拍照，以及给朋友安利各种奇奇怪怪的好东西——「推荐」那页就是罪证。
en: Hi, I'm Chen Mo, a full-stack engineer in Hangzhou, six years into writing code. I believe good software is made by deletion — strip away layer after layer of unnecessary complexity, and what remains is the product.

By day I build services with TypeScript and Go; by night I maintain a few small open-source projects. I have a soft spot for editors, dev tools and "small but certain" software: if a tool can stay under 100kb and still delight, it deserves to exist.
When I'm not coding, I'm learning English, taking photos, and pushing oddly specific recommendations onto friends — the Recommendations page is the evidence.
